assignment.rationale: Explicit exclusion: generated document-relationship navigation, not a static product topology and not a Mermaid migration target. The #397 audit retained it as working interactive navigation, so no allocation to #288 is needed.

visuals.rationale: Retained as working interactive navigation by the #397 browser audit (docs/reference/visualization-audit.md). On the published site it draws 30 nodes and 69 edges, search, filter and reset work, all 30 node links return 200 and a node click opens its page (tested on one node). Defects recorded and not fixed here: the committed data is a snapshot of 30 of the 159 nodes that the generator now produces from 253 files (it keeps one node for each slug and overwrites 94 files), the labels are black on a dark background in dark mode (contrast 1.47:1), the graph cannot be reached by keyboard, and wheel and touch gestures over it move it and not the page.

assignment.rationale: Explicit exclusion: generated playbook/lab navigation, separate from the Mermaid incident diagrams owned by #287 and not a Mermaid migration target. The #397 audit retained it as working interactive navigation, so no allocation to #288 is needed.

visuals.rationale: Retained as working interactive navigation by the #397 browser audit (docs/reference/visualization-audit.md). On the published site it draws 24 nodes and 57 edges, search, filter and reset work, all 24 node links return 200 and a node click opens its page (tested on one node). The committed data is a snapshot of 24 of the 77 nodes that the generator now produces (8 of 52 playbooks), and the map has the same dark-mode, keyboard and gesture defects as the core graph. Documented: the page and the script's empty-state message now name tools/build_doc_graph.py and state that it rewrites docs/assets/graph/troubleshooting-map.json and docs/assets/graph/core-knowledge.json. The historical wrong-producer reference remains documented at pinned sources in the audit; correcting its name changes neither graph data nor graph behavior.

assignment.rationale: Explicit exclusion: auxiliary learning-path graph containers are not interactive navigation and not a Mermaid migration target. The #397 audit found no initializer, data or producer and justified their removal, which is proposed as a separate change.

visuals.rationale: The #397 browser audit (docs/reference/visualization-audit.md) found the Python, Node.js, Java and .NET containers to be empty 400 px bordered boxes with no child, no canvas, no initializer and no learning-path data. tools/build_doc_graph.py accepts --learning-paths but never reads it, while the page tells readers to run it. There is nothing to retain and no producer to repair, so removal of the four containers and of the instruction is justified and proposed as a separate change for review. The page's three Mermaid learning-path diagrams remain in migration scope.
